question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
WITH match_runs_per_striker AS (
  SELECT bb.striker, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bs.runs_scored > 0
  GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker
  FROM match_runs_per_striker
  WHERE match_runs > 50
),
total_runs_per_striker AS (
  SELECT mr.striker, SUM(mr.match_runs) as total_runs
  FROM match_runs_per_striker mr
  JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON mr.striker = qs.striker
  GROUP BY mr.striker
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as qualifying_striker_count, AVG(total_runs) as avg_total_runs, MIN(total_runs) as min_total, MAX(total_runs) as max_total
FROM total_runs_per_striker
